summary: Xeris Biopharma Holdings filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing that on October 13, 2026, its wholly owned subsidiary Xeris Pharmaceuticals sued Torrent Pharma, Torrent Pharmaceuticals, Cycle Pharmaceuticals, Lemed Pharmacy III and Lemed Specialty Pharmacy Arizona, plus Rising Pharma Holdings and Rising Pharma Specialties, in two actions in the U.S. District Court for New Jersey. The suits follow grant of U.S. Patent No. 12,758,502 covering KEVEYIS (dichlorphenamide) and allege the defendants will infringe by making, using, selling, offering or importing generic dichlorphenamide, seeking injunction, damages, enhanced damages, fees and costs. This is ordinary patent litigation, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors or board recommendation apply. Watch for ANDA litigation milestones and any stay or settlement affecting generic entry timing.
